intro: Rejold Barleybrew of Brewnall Village is determined to craft the ultimate dwarven stout, combining family brewing tradition with exotic local ingredients. To perfect his experimental recipe, he seeks shimmerweed, a pungent plant cultivated exclusively by the hostile Frostmane trolls atop Shimmer Ridge. Daring travelers are sent into the troll encampment to lift the herb straight from tribal baskets.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I'm on a quest, a quest to make the perfect stout. I know I can do it -- brewing's in my blood. I just need to find the right recipe...

The Frostmane trolls grow a plant, shimmerweed, high up in the hills to the east. They use it in their strange, tribal rituals. We dwarves haven't found much use for it, but it has a unique taste...and I want to experiment with it in my brews!
Get me some shimmerweed from Frostmane seers, or swipe it from the trolls' shimmerweed baskets.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Do you have that shimmerweed? I almost have a batch of stout ready to brew, and I want to try throwing the weed in with this mixture.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Great! I can't wait to use these in some of my recipes. There's one in particular I think it'll work great in...
